edit.subject: died_in_year
edit.scope: Whether the year a person died in rules out every other year as the year of their death.

direct.prompt: Is the relation 'died in year' functional, so that a person died in at most one year?

cross_lingual.prompt: 查理曼死于814年。能否由此推出查理曼并非死于815年？
Carlomagno murió en el año 814. ¿Se deduce que Carlomagno no murió en el año 815?

propositional.prompt: Is it false that the relation 'died in year' is functional?
Is it true that the relation 'died in year' is functional or that the relation 'was the mother of' is symmetric?
propositional.side_fact: The relation 'was the mother of' is symmetric.

unrelated_near.prompt: Is the relation 'ended in year', for a historical event, functional, so that an event ended in at most one year?

unrelated_far.prompt: Is the relation 'is younger than' transitive?

derived.prompt: Charlemagne died in 814. Does it follow that Charlemagne did not die in 815?
chain: Nothing else licenses the step, so whether Charlemagne did not die in 815 can no longer be concluded.

derived.prompt: William the Conqueror died in 1087. Does it follow that William the Conqueror did not die in 1090?
chain: William the Conqueror died in 1087. (given in prompt)
Nothing else licenses the step, so whether William the Conqueror did not die in 1090 can no longer be concluded.
